//install: Pure declarative language registration for .sprf files. No LSP client.
Lane C will add an LSP client once v4 ships sprefa-lsp.
Verify by opening any .sprf file. The example
should color `rule`/`str` as op names, `:greet` as atom, the backtick body
as a string, and brace/paren delimiters as bracket pairs.
name: sprefa-v4
description: Syntax highlighting for .sprf rule files (v4 host grammar). Installable alongside the v3 sprf extension.
